svg.title: Jacksonville Center (ZJX) — The Florida Bottleneck
svg.desc: Diagram showing how all north-south commercial traffic funnels through ZJX airspace before reaching Florida destinations, with compounding stress factors labeled

g.text: 210,000 sq mi · 2.61M aircraft in 2024 · 3rd busiest ARTCC in the U.S.
40+ sectors · 160K sq mi over FL, GA, AL, SC, NC · 8,600 daily operations avg
20% military traffic · rocket launch TFRs · Caribbean overflights · hurricane season

svg.text: ZJX: Every flight into Florida must pass through this single en route center
When ZJX slows — staffing, weather, equipment, or launches — the entire East Coast departure board backs up
